integrity: Every claim has an unrestricted symbolic proof and bounded numerical reproduction; the numerical reproduction is not certification.
scientific_limitations: Canonical signed adjacency-polynomial certificate only for m>=3, k>=3, ell>=2k-1, equal arms. Historical priority unverified; no independent audit.
title: A signed adjacency-polynomial certificate for long-arm spider powers
